Networking

Networking courses covering architecture and design, CCDE preparation, and hands-on CCIE Data Center practice across routing and VXLAN.

Notes on network design, architecture, and analysis. Spans formal study toward professional certifications and applied work bridging networking with data science and machine learning.

Areas of Study

CCDE Written

Study notes prepared for the Cisco Certified Design Expert (CCDE) Written exam. Covers enterprise network design across campus, data center, WAN, security, automation, multicast, wireless, and service architectures.

  • Network Design
  • Designing for Business Success
  • What's the Purpose of the Network?
  • Security Is Pervasive
  • Reference Architecture Models and Frameworks
  • Transport Technologies
  • Layer 2 Technologies
  • Layer 3 Technologies
  • Network Virtualization
  • Security
  • Wireless
  • Automation
  • Multicast Design
  • Network Services and Management
  • Scalable Enterprise Campus Architecture Design
  • Enterprise Internet Edge Architecture Design
  • Enterprise WAN Architecture Design

CCIE Data Center

Study and lab notes I wrote while practicing toward the Cisco CCIE Data Center v3.0 practical exam. Covers NX-OS, Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies, vPC, multicast, and VXLAN BGP EVPN.

  • Introduction to NX-OS Command Line
  • Cisco Nexus 7000 Series Virtual Device Contexts (VDC)
  • VLANs and Trunks
  • Inter-VLAN Routing (IVR)
  • Rapid Spanning-Tree Protocol
  • Multiple Spanning Tree Protocol (IEEE 802.1s)
  • Optional Spanning-Tree Features
  • Campus LAN and Spine-Leaf Network Design
  • Port-Channel (Ether-Channel)
  • Virtual Port Channel (vPC)
  • vPC Configuration
  • vPC Initialization and Failure Scenarios
  • First Hop Redundancy Protocol (FHRP)
  • vPC Advanced Topics
  • Double-Sided vPC
  • Introduction to IP Routing and VRF Lite
  • Open Shortest-Path First (OSPF)
  • Intermediate System to Intermediate System (IS-IS)
  • Border Gateway Protocol (BGP)
  • Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD)
  • Infrastructure Monitoring
  • IP Multicast Overview
  • IP Multicast: Distribution Trees
  • IP Multicast: Protocol Independent Multicast (PIM)
  • IP Multicast: PIM Rendezvous Point (RP)
  • Virtual eXtensible LAN (VXLAN)
  • VXLAN Underlay and Overlay Consideration
  • VXLAN Flood and Learn with Ingress Replication
  • VXLAN Flood and Learn with Multicast
  • VXLAN Fabric Ingress Replication with BGP EVPN as Control Plane
  • VXLAN Fabric Multicast with MP-BGP as Control Plane
  • VXLAN Integrated Route and Bridge (IRB)
  • BGP EVPN Route Types
  • VXLAN Fabric External Connectivity
  • vPC in VXLAN BGP EVPN
  • Introduction to Storage and Storage Networking

Networking Archive

Notes I wrote while studying for certification tracks that have since retired. I have kept them close to how I first wrote them, so read them as a record of how I learned the material rather than as current exam preparation. The Archive lists every retired track.
